sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Vintage 1940s wartime poster and storybook illustration: bold dark ink outlines, flat gouache colour with simple blocked-in shading and a slightly limited screen-printed look. Characters are expressive dogs in army uniforms with lightly caricatured proportions, big characterful faces and simplified fur shapes that keep each breed easy to recognise. Backgrounds are simple, stylised shapes. Palette: olive drab, khaki, gunmetal, brass and aged canvas, with dark ink for lines. Subtle aged paper grain over everything. Overall mood: dignified and characterful, with a quiet sense of humour coming from how seriously the dogs take their duties.
frame: Border: a thick border of riveted, worn olive-drab painted steel with chipped paint, brass corner plates and small hex bolts, like the side of an old military vehicle. Drawn in the same illustrated style, seen straight on.
Top-left corner: a small brass shield emblem with an embossed paw print above two crossed bones, with no letters.
Top: an empty name plate shaped like a long brushed-steel dog tag with rounded ends and a brass edge, pale in colour, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a pale aged-canvas text panel below the window, about a quarter of the card height, with a thin dark stitched edge. The upper half of the panel is empty space for flavour text. A thin dark divider line runs across the middle of the panel.

Stats row: the lower half of the panel is split into three equal cells by thin vertical dark dividers. Each cell has one small bold icon hard against its left edge, vertically centred, and every icon is the same size: no wider than a quarter of the cell and no taller than half of the cell. The right three-quarters of every cell is completely empty space for a word like 'DISCIPLINE' and a large number. The icons, left to right: a small brass star medal on a ribbon; three small stacked military chevrons; a single sharp white canine fang. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in olive drab, brass, gunmetal and dark ink.

Card number and rarity: below the panel, on the border, two separate empty badges of the same height. In the bottom-left corner, a wide dark gunmetal plaque with a brass edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#30 of 30'. In the bottom-right corner, a wide pill-shaped pale canvas badge with a brass edge for the rarity, about 25% of the card width, so it can hold a word of nine capital letters. Both are empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only olive drab, khaki, gunmetal, brass, dark ink and pale canvas. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No photorealism, no photograph, no camera depth of field, no 3D render, no anime style, no human soldiers or people, no injuries, no blood, no gore, no guns being fired, no real national flags, no real regimental badges or military insignia, no political symbols, no swastikas or other extremist symbols, no text on badges or uniforms, no watermarks, no extra text, no blurry or cut-off borders.

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, drawn in the same illustrated style as the frame. A design mirrored top to bottom, so it looks the same either way up, with no single upright object in the middle: a thick border of riveted, worn olive-drab painted steel with brass corner plates and small hex bolts, around a dark gunmetal centre panel. In the centre, a brass diamond with two crossed bones lying flat on it, with an embossed brass paw print above them and the same paw print mirrored upside down below them. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.
